title: Tithe-Lock Audit
text: A floating seal-engine traps the chosen operative inside intersecting receipt beams. On failure, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The lock opens only after deciding what part of you counts as payment.

successEffect.text: You broke the audit lattice and recovered a cooled seal tooth.
